title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): on fresh seed 4 vesicles form from noise and die when the feed is cut, but the catalyst never sits on them: it stays on one open strip in a corner and the K-free vesicles live on amphiphile shared through the bath
summary: I looked at channels_seed2.png, channels_seed0_seed1.png and starve_fork.png, then re-ran world.py on seed 4 (192^2, T=600) and world_starve.py (feed cut at t=300) on the same seed. Bilayer vesicles form from the noisy bath by t~90 and two closed vesicles persist to t=600 in the fed run (chan_s4.png row 1). The catalyst K, however, lives only on an open bilayer strip and a spot at the domain corner from t~90 on (chan_s4.png row 3; K on the central region at t=600 is 28 of 1696); neither persistent vesicle carries a K layer at any time. When the feed is cut the vesicles shrink and break into micelle clusters by t=600 while the fed twins keep their size (fork_s4.png; amphiphile 323 vs 2062, K 274 vs 1696). So S, I and a feed dependence of the vesicles replicate, but the claimed individuals, vesicles that carry their own catalyst layer, do not appear on this seed: the vesicles are sustained by amphiphile made elsewhere, as the claim itself notes for seed 1.

observations.I: chan_s4.png row 1 f57-f200: two closed vesicles persist from t~170 to t=600
observations.E: fork_s4.png: after the feed cut at t=300 the vesicles shrink and break into micelle clusters by t=600 while the fed twins persist (amphiphile 323 vs 2062)

seeds_run.result: partial: vesicles from noise persist on the feed and die without it, but none carries K (K only on an open corner strip); labkit K rim/core 0.46, 0/27 individuals membrane-like

controls_run.E: starve/seed4 (world_starve.py, feed cut at t=300) with the fed twin rerun/seed4

verdicts.limitation: B is not seen on this seed: the catalyst layer is absent from every persistent vesicle, so the individuals that show E are not the K-carrying ones of the statement; with seed 1 that makes 2 of 4 seeds where vesicles live without their own catalyst, and their metabolism is a bath-level process. E holds largely by construction (amphiphile made only by K from P, with decay). One seed.
